Branch utilities and requirement coverage: - File: src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts - DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES constant: - ["IfStatement", "SwitchCase", "TryStatement", "CatchClause", "ForStatement", "ForOfStatement", "ForInStatement", "WhileStatement", "DoWhileStatement"] - JSDoc: @story docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md, @req REQ-SIGNIFICANCE-CRITERIA. - Satisfies REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION and REQ-SIGNIFICANCE-CRITERIA by defining which branch node kinds are considered significant by default. - validateBranchTypes(context): - JSDoc: @story docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md, @req REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE. - Reads options = context.options[0] || {} and options.branchTypes. - If branchTypes is an array: - Uses isInvalidType() (with its own @story/@req JSDoc) and DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES.includes to derive invalidTypes. - If invalidTypes.length > 0: - Constructs ProgramHandler that, for each invalid type, calls context.report with message: - `Value "${t}" should be equal to one of the allowed values: ${DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES.join(", ")}`. - Returns { Program: ProgramHandler } as a RuleListener, causing ESLint to report configuration errors on Program. - If no invalid types, returns options.branchTypes as BranchType[]. - If branchTypes is not an array, returns a copy of DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES using Array.from. - This implements REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE and configuration error behavior. - gatherBranchCommentText(sourceCode, node): - JSDoc: @story docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md, @req REQ-COMMENT-ASSOCIATION. - Special handling when node.type === "SwitchCase": - Uses sourceCode.lines and node.loc.start.line. - Walks upwards from (startLine - PRE_COMMENT_OFFSET) while lines match /^\s*(\/\/|\/\*)/. - Accumulates trimmed comment lines in an array and joins them with spaces. - This supports detection of comments immediately above the case label, including the blank-line edge case described in tests. - For other branch nodes: - Uses sourceCode.getCommentsBefore(node) and maps comment nodes to comment.value. - Joins values with spaces. - This fulfills REQ-COMMENT-ASSOCIATION with support for both // and /* */ styles. - reportMissingStory(context, node, { indent, insertPos, storyFixCountRef }): - JSDoc: @story docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md, @req REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING. - If storyFixCountRef.count === 0: - Defines insertStoryFixer(fixer) that inserts `${indent}// @story .story.md\n` before [insertPos, insertPos]. - Calls context.report({ node, messageId: "missingAnnotation", data: { missing: "@story" }, fix: insertStoryFixer }). - Increments storyFixCountRef.count. - Else, reports missing @story without fix. - reportMissingReq(context, node, { indent, insertPos, missingStory }): - JSDoc: @story docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md, @req REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING. - If !missingStory: - Provides fixer insertReqFixer(fixer) that inserts `${indent}// @req \n` before insertPos. - Reports missingAnnotation with data { missing: "@req" } and fixer. - If missingStory is true, reports missing @req without fix (so fixes are applied in a sensible order). - reportMissingAnnotations(context, node, storyFixCountRef): - JSDoc: @story docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md, @req REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING. - Obtains sourceCode from context.getSourceCode(). - text = gatherBranchCommentText(sourceCode, node). - missingStory = !/@story\b/.test(text), missingReq = !/@req\b/.test(text). - Computes indent from sourceCode.lines[node.loc.start.line - 1].match(/^(\s*)/). - insertPos from sourceCode.getIndexFromLoc({ line: node.loc.start.line, column: 0 }). - Builds actions array for potential story and req reports; if `missing` is true, executes action.fn(...action.args). - This centralizes detection and reporting logic and supports nested branches via ESLint's normal traversal.

traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for story 004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS are satisfied: - Core Functionality: The `require-branch-annotation` rule detects missing @story and/or @req annotations on significant branches (if/else, switch cases, loops, try/catch) via DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES and reportMissingAnnotations; this behavior is thoroughly verified by tests in tests/rules/require-branch-annotation.test.ts. - Quality Standards: The rule is implemented as a standard ESLint RuleModule with proper meta, schema, and messages, uses helper utilities for separation of concerns, and supports autofix in a controlled manner, aligning with ESLint best practices. - Integration: The rule supports a wide set of branch node types including nested structures (handled naturally by ESLint traversal). It is integrated into the plugin via src/index.ts and enabled at error severity in both recommended and strict configs. - User Experience: Error messages use the shared `missingAnnotation` message with a `{{missing}}` placeholder, yielding specific messages like "Branch is missing required annotation: @story" or "@req". Tests assert these messageIds and the autofix outputs, and documentation shows clear examples. - Error Handling: validateBranchTypes reports invalid branchTypes configuration using a dedicated Program listener and a clear message listing allowed values. The branch handlers also explicitly skip default switch cases, demonstrating thoughtful edge-case handling. The comment-gathering logic for SwitchCase accounts for blank lines and comment placement, as shown by the tests. - Documentation: docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md documents the rule, configuration, examples, and invalid-configuration behavior, and is explicitly linked to this story via @story annotations.
Given the implemented rule, utilities, comprehensive tests tied to this story, integration in the plugin presets, and successful test execution, the story is fully implemented and passes assessment.
